notes.title: Update #2 and OST coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hey Y'all,

Daner here. I know it's only been a day since the last update, but I fixed some things that will hopefully make some people very happy.

Here's the patch notes:

Fixed a number of collision glitches
Fixed stretching on monitors with non-16:9 monitors.
Controller users now have the option between the d-pad and analog stick to control the player.


Also, the official OST will be posted on bandcamp for free later in the week. I'm currently working on extending and remastering the tracks.

Peace and Love!
Daner

notes.title: First Update and Thank You!
notes.notes:
Hey y'all,

Daner here. I've been blown away by the support that Foto Flash has gotten in such a short amount of time. From the bottom of my heart, thank you!

Here's the patch notes:

Fixed as much as possible the black bar graphical glitch seen on lower resolution monitors
Added a return to Main Menu option in-game.
Added extra numbers for the secret achievement.
Added a censor mode that was requested by streamers.
Changed the wall color in the magazine office.
Added a single tree. I refuse to say where.

I'm still working on other bugs and issues people have brought up. If you find any other issues, please let me know and I'll try to fix it as soon as possible.

Peace and Love!
Daner
